name: Regular icosahedron
description: The regular icosahedron is a platonic solid with 20 equilatral triangle faces. It can be constructed by taking the dual of a regular dodecahedron, gyroelongating a pentagonal bipyramid or taking the snub of a regular tetrahedron. It is one of the 8 strictly convex deltahedra

sections.Properties:
Convex
Composite
Isogonal
Isohedral
Isotoxal
Deltahedron

trivia: Three perpendicular golden rectangles can form an icosahedron if their corners are connected with edges
Many viruses have an icosahedral shell due to it being the simplest form that can be arranged from protein subunits
There are 43380 possible nets for the regular icosahedron
The regular icosahedron is commonly used as a D20 in tabletop games
Plato originally stated that the icosahedron represents water as an element
